101	// ---- Epilog interaction count helpers --------------------------------------
102	
103	_assert_interaction :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine, id_a, id_b: u32, count: u32) {
104	    buf_a, buf_b, buf_src: [128]u8
105	    atom_a := character_atom(id_a, buf_a[:])
106	    atom_b := character_atom(id_b, buf_b[:])
107	
108	    // Retract old count first (ignore failure — might not exist)
109	    rs := fmt.bprintf(buf_src[:], "interaction_count(%s, %s, _)", atom_a, atom_b)
110	    buf_src[len(rs)] = 0
111	    // Epilog doesn't have retract in the FFI, so we just re-assert.
112	    // Because Epilog indexes by first arg, the newer fact shadows the older one
113	    // for queries. In practice we'll accumulate duplicates but queries still work.
114	    as := fmt.bprintf(buf_src[:], "interaction_count(%s, %s, %d).", atom_a, atom_b, count)
115	    buf_src[len(as)] = 0
116	    epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(buf_src[:])))
117	}
118	
119	_assert_crush :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine, from_id, on_id: u32) {
120	    buf_a, buf_b, buf_src: [128]u8
121	    atom_a := character_atom(from_id, buf_a[:])
122	    atom_b := character_atom(on_id, buf_b[:])
123	    s := fmt.bprintf(buf_src[:], "crushing(%s, %s).", atom_a, atom_b)
124	    buf_src[len(s)] = 0
125	    epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(buf_src[:])))
126	}
127	
128	_assert_mood :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine, id: u32, m: Mood) {
129	    buf_id, buf_src: [128]u8
130	    atom := character_atom(id, buf_id[:])
131	    s := fmt.bprintf(buf_src[:], "mood(%s, %s).", atom, mood_label(m))
132	    buf_src[len(s)] = 0
133	    epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(buf_src[:])))
134	}
135	
136	// ---- Epilog query helpers (callbacks use "c" ABI) --------------------------
137	
138	_BoolResult :: struct { found: bool }
139	
140	_bool_cb :: proc "c" (soln: ^EpilogSolution, ud: rawptr) -> EpilogSignal {
141	    r := cast(^_BoolResult)ud
142	    r.found = true
143	    return .EPILOG_STOP
144	}
145	
146	_epilog_bool :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine, goal: string) -> bool {
147	    buf: [256]u8
148	    gs := fmt.bprintf(buf[:], "%s", goal)
149	    buf[len(gs)] = 0
150	    r := _BoolResult{false}
151	    epilog_query(engine, cstring(raw_data(buf[:])), _bool_cb, &r)
152	    return r.found
153	}
154	
155	// Count solutions (up to cap)
156	_CountResult :: struct { n: int, cap: int }
157	
158	_count_cb :: proc "c" (soln: ^EpilogSolution, ud: rawptr) -> EpilogSignal {
159	    r := cast(^_CountResult)ud
160	    r.n += 1
161	    if r.n >= r.cap do return .EPILOG_STOP
162	    return .EPILOG_NEXT
163	}
164	
165	_epilog_count :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine, goal: string, cap: int) -> int {
166	    buf: [256]u8
167	    gs := fmt.bprintf(buf[:], "%s", goal)
168	    buf[len(gs)] = 0
169	    r := _CountResult{0, cap}
170	    epilog_query(engine, cstring(raw_data(buf[:])), _count_cb, &r)
171	    return r.n
172	}
173	
174	// ---- Load M5 Epilog rules --------------------------------------------------
175	
176	sim_load_rules :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine) {
177	    // Mood derivation rules
178	    epilog_load_string(engine,
179	        "mood(X, jealous) :- rivals(X, _).")
180	    epilog_load_string(engine,
181	        "mood(X, lovestruck) :- crushing(X, _).")
182	    epilog_load_string(engine,
183	        "mood(X, happy) :- best_friends(X, _).")
184	    epilog_load_string(engine,
185	        "mood(X, sad) :- relationship(X, _, partner), crushing(_, X).")
186	    // unrequited: X crushes on Y but Y doesn't crush on X
187	    epilog_load_string(engine,
188	        "unrequited(X, Y) :- crushing(X, Y), \\+ crushing(Y, X).")
189	}
190	
191	// ---- Proximity check -------------------------------------------------------
192	// Two characters are "near" if they are within NEAR_DIST grid cells.
193	
194	NEAR_DIST :: 8
195	
196	_chars_near :: proc(a, b: ^Character) -> bool {
197	    dx := a.position[0] - b.position[0]
198	    dy := a.position[1] - b.position[1]
199	    if dx < 0 { dx = -dx }
200	    if dy < 0 { dy = -dy }
201	    return dx + dy <= NEAR_DIST
202	}
203	
204	// ---- Main simulation tick --------------------------------------------------
205	
206	// Global pointers set by main — nil-safe throughout.
207	g_decay   : ^FriendshipDecay
208	g_bubbles : ^BubbleSystem
209	
210	sim_tick :: proc(s: ^SimState, res: ^Residents, engine: ^EpilogEngine, tick: u64) {
211	    // 1. Proximity — increment interaction counts
212	    for i in 0..<res.count {
213	        for j in i+1..<res.count {
214	            a := &res.chars[i]
215	            b := &res.chars[j]
216	            if _chars_near(a, b) {
217	                ia := int(a.id - 1)
218	                ib := int(b.id - 1)
219	                if ia < MAX_RESIDENTS { s.social[ia].interaction_count += 1 }
220	                if ib < MAX_RESIDENTS { s.social[ib].interaction_count += 1 }
221	                cnt_a := s.social[ia].interaction_count
222	                _assert_interaction(engine, a.id, b.id, cnt_a)
223	                if g_decay != nil {
224	                    friendship_decay_record(g_decay, a.id, b.id, tick)
225	                }
226	                // Dialogue bubble (low probability to avoid spam)
227	                if g_bubbles != nil && dependent_next(&s.rng) < 0.05 {
228	                    rel_tag := "acquaintance"
229	                    if ia < MAX_RESIDENTS && s.social[ia].has_crush { rel_tag = "crush" }
230	                    bubble_on_interact(g_bubbles, a, b, rel_tag, &s.rng)
231	                }
232	
233	                // 2. Crush development (gate: eligible query + RNG threshold)
234	                if !s.social[ia].has_crush {
235	                    chance := 0.003  // ~0.3% per proximity tick per character
236	                    roll   := dependent_next(&s.rng)
237	                    if roll < chance {
238	                        buf_a, buf_b, goal_buf: [128]u8
239	                        atom_a := character_atom(a.id, buf_a[:])
240	                        atom_b := character_atom(b.id, buf_b[:])
241	                        gs := fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "eligible(%s, %s)", atom_a, atom_b)
242	                        goal_buf[len(gs)] = 0
243	                        if _epilog_bool(engine, string(goal_buf[:len(gs)])) {
244	                            _assert_crush(engine, a.id, b.id)
245	                            s.social[ia].has_crush = true
246	                            // Event log
247	                            msg_buf: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
248	                            name_a := character_name(a)
249	                            name_b := character_name(b)
250	                            ms := fmt.bprintf(msg_buf[:], "%s develops a crush on %s", name_a, name_b)
251	                            event_log_push(&s.log, tick, string(msg_buf[:len(ms)]))
252	                        }
253	                    }
254	                }
255	            }
256	        }
257	    }
258	
259	    // 3. Re-derive moods and assert them
260	    for i in 0..<res.count {
261	        c  := &res.chars[i]
262	        ia := int(c.id - 1)
263	        if ia >= MAX_RESIDENTS do continue
264	
265	        buf_id, goal_buf: [64]u8
266	        atom := character_atom(c.id, buf_id[:])
267	
268	        // Check rivals
269	        gs := fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "rivals(%s, _)", atom)
270	        goal_buf[len(gs)] = 0
271	        if _epilog_bool(engine, string(goal_buf[:len(gs)])) {
272	            s.social[ia].mood = .Jealous
273	            _assert_mood(engine, c.id, .Jealous)
274	            continue
275	        }
276	
277	        // Check crushing
278	        gs = fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "crushing(%s, _)", atom)
279	        goal_buf[len(gs)] = 0
280	        if _epilog_bool(engine, string(goal_buf[:len(gs)])) {
281	            s.social[ia].mood = .Lovestruck
282	            _assert_mood(engine, c.id, .Lovestruck)
283	            continue
284	        }
285	
286	        // Check best_friends
287	        gs = fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "best_friends(%s, _)", atom)
288	        goal_buf[len(gs)] = 0
289	        if _epilog_bool(engine, string(goal_buf[:len(gs)])) {
290	            s.social[ia].mood = .Happy
291	            _assert_mood(engine, c.id, .Happy)
292	            continue
293	        }
294	
295	        s.social[ia].mood = .Content
296	        _assert_mood(engine, c.id, .Content)
297	    }
298	
299	    // 4. Update summary counters for stats panel display
300	    crush_buf, rival_buf: [64]u8
301	    cs := fmt.bprintf(crush_buf[:], "crushing(_, _)")
302	    crush_buf[len(cs)] = 0
303	    rs := fmt.bprintf(rival_buf[:], "rivals(_, _)")
304	    rival_buf[len(rs)] = 0
305	    s.crush_count = _epilog_count(engine, string(crush_buf[:len(cs)]), 64)
306	    s.rival_count = _epilog_count(engine, string(rival_buf[:len(rs)]), 64) / 2  // pairs
307	}

102	// ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
103	
104	_parse_seed :: proc(s: string) -> (u64, bool) {
105	    val := u64(0)
106	    if len(s) == 0 do return 0, false
107	    for ch in s {
108	        switch ch {
109	        case '0'..='9': val = val * 16 + u64(ch - '0')
110	        case 'a'..='f': val = val * 16 + u64(ch - 'a' + 10)
111	        case 'A'..='F': val = val * 16 + u64(ch - 'A' + 10)
112	        case: return 0, false
113	        }
114	    }
115	    return val, true
116	}
117	
118	_default_seed :: proc() -> u64 {
119	    return 0x596767647261736C
120	}

126	}

128	_do_load :: proc(app: ^App) -> bool {
129	    epilog_destroy(app.engine)
130	    app.engine = epilog_create()
131	    _load_all_rules(app)
132	
133	    ok := load_game(SAVE_PATH, &app.world, &app.residents, &app.sim, app.engine, &app.island_name)
134	    if ok {
135	        zone_labels_seed(&app.zone_labels, &app.world.grid)
136	        sim_tick(&app.sim, &app.residents, app.engine, app.world.tick)
137	        app.cam_col = GRID_W / 2
138	        app.cam_row = GRID_H / 2
139	        _draw_stat_panel(app)
140	    }
141	    return ok
142	}

175	_draw_world_setup :: proc(app: ^App) -> bool {
176	    rl.ClearBackground(COL_BG)
177	    rl.DrawText("DMLS", UI_LPAD, UI_PAD, 48, COL_TEXT)
178	    rl.DrawText("Deb's Minimal Life Simulator", UI_LPAD, UI_PAD + 54, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
179	
180	    y := i32(UI_PAD + 110)
181	    rl.DrawText("World seed (hex)", UI_LPAD, y, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
182	    y += 22
183	
184	    input_field_draw(&app.seed_field, UI_LPAD, y, 340, 38, "")
185	    if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(),
186	            rl.Rectangle{f32(UI_LPAD), f32(y), 340, 38}) &&
187	            rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
188	        app.seed_field.active = true
189	    }
190	    input_field_update(&app.seed_field)
191	
192	    if app.seed_err {
193	        rl.DrawText("Invalid hex seed", UI_LPAD, y + 44, UI_SMALL, rl.RED)
194	    }
195	
196	    y += 54
197	    rnd_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(UI_LPAD + 350), f32(y - 54), 160, 38}
198	    hov_rnd  := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), rnd_rect)
199	    rl.DrawRectangleRec(rnd_rect, hov_rnd ? COL_HOVER : COL_INPUT)
200	    rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rnd_rect, 1, COL_MUTED)
201	    rl.DrawText("Random seed", UI_LPAD + 360, y - 44, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
202	    if hov_rnd && rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
203	        rng := u64(rl.GetTime() * 1e9)
204	        rng ~= rng << 13; rng ~= rng >> 7; rng ~= rng << 17
205	        buf: [20]u8
206	        ns := fmt.bprintf(buf[:], "%016X", rng)
207	        app.seed_field.len = 0
208	        for i in 0..<len(ns) { app.seed_field.buf[i] = buf[i] }
209	        app.seed_field.len = len(ns)
210	    }
211	
212	    go_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(UI_LPAD), f32(y), 200, 42}
213	    hov_go  := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), go_rect)
214	    rl.DrawRectangleRec(go_rect, hov_go ? COL_ACCENT : COL_SELECT)
215	    rl.DrawText("Generate island ->", UI_LPAD + 12, y + 11, UI_FSIZE, COL_TEXT)
216	
217	    if (hov_go && rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT)) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ENTER) {
218	        seed_str := input_field_str(&app.seed_field)
219	        seed     := u64(0)
220	        ok       := false
221	        if len(seed_str) == 0 {
222	            seed, ok = _default_seed(), true
223	        } else {
224	            seed, ok = _parse_seed(seed_str)
225	        }
226	        if !ok { app.seed_err = true; return false }
227	        app.seed_err = false
228	        world_init(&app.world, seed)
229	        return true
230	    }
231	
232	    // Back button → Title
233	    if _draw_back_btn() {
234	        app.screen = .Title
235	    }
236	    if _draw_exit_btn() || rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE) {
237	        rl.CloseWindow()
238	    }
239	    return false
240	}

248	// ---- Grid-to-screen coordinate mapping ------------------------------------
249	
250	_grid_to_screen :: proc(gc, gr, cam_col, cam_row, view_w, view_h: i32) -> (px, py: i32, visible: bool) {
251	    cpx          := render_cell_px()
252	    visible_cols := view_w  / cpx + 2
253	    visible_rows := view_h / cpx + 2
254	    start_col    := cam_col - visible_cols / 2
255	    start_row    := cam_row - visible_rows / 2
256	    dc           := gc - start_col
257	    dr           := gr - start_row
258	    if dc < 0 || dc >= visible_cols || dr < 0 || dr >= visible_rows {
259	        return 0, 0, false
260	    }
261	    return dc * cpx, dr * cpx, true
262	}

264	// ---- Hover arrow query (c-callback, no context) ----------------------------
265	
266	MAX_ARROW_TAG :: 24
267	
268	_HoverRelEntry :: struct {
269	    id  : u32,
270	    tag : [MAX_ARROW_TAG]u8,
271	}
272	
273	_HoverRelAccum :: struct {
274	    entries : [MAX_RESIDENTS]_HoverRelEntry,
275	    count   : int,
276	}
277	
278	_hover_rel_cb :: proc "c" (soln: ^EpilogSolution, ud: rawptr) -> EpilogSignal {
279	    acc := cast(^_HoverRelAccum)ud
280	    if acc.count >= MAX_RESIDENTS do return .EPILOG_STOP
281	
282	    other_atom: cstring
283	    tag_atom  : cstring
284	
285	    for i in 0..<epilog_soln_var_count(soln) {
286	        vname := epilog_soln_var_name(soln, i)
287	        val   := epilog_soln_var_atom(soln, i)
288	        if vname == nil || val == nil do continue
289	        switch string(vname) {
290	        case "Other": other_atom = val
291	        case "Tag":   tag_atom   = val
292	        }
293	    }
294	
295	    if other_atom != nil {
296	        other_str := string(other_atom)
297	        other_id  := u32(0)
298	        if len(other_str) > 5 && other_str[:5] == "char_" {
299	            for ch in other_str[5:] {
300	                if ch >= '0' && ch <= '9' {
301	                    other_id = other_id * 10 + u32(ch - '0')
302	                }
303	            }
304	        }
305	        idx := acc.count
306	        acc.entries[idx].id = other_id
307	        if tag_atom != nil {
308	            ts := string(tag_atom)
309	            n  := min(len(ts), MAX_ARROW_TAG - 1)
310	            copy(acc.entries[idx].tag[:], ts[:n])
311	            acc.entries[idx].tag[n] = 0
312	        }
313	        acc.count += 1
314	    }
315	    return .EPILOG_NEXT
316	}
317	
318	// Also query crush/2 and rival state for additional arrow colours
319	_CrushAccum :: struct {
320	    ids   : [MAX_RESIDENTS]u32,
321	    count : int,
322	}
323	
324	_crush_cb :: proc "c" (soln: ^EpilogSolution, ud: rawptr) -> EpilogSignal {
325	    acc := cast(^_CrushAccum)ud
326	    if acc.count >= MAX_RESIDENTS do return .EPILOG_STOP
327	    for i in 0..<epilog_soln_var_count(soln) {
328	        vname := epilog_soln_var_name(soln, i)
329	        val   := epilog_soln_var_atom(soln, i)
330	        if vname == nil || val == nil do continue
331	        if string(vname) == "Y" {
332	            other_str := string(val)
333	            other_id  := u32(0)
334	            if len(other_str) > 5 && other_str[:5] == "char_" {
335	                for ch in other_str[5:] {
336	                    if ch >= '0' && ch <= '9' {
337	                        other_id = other_id * 10 + u32(ch - '0')
338	                    }
339	                }
340	            }
341	            acc.ids[acc.count] = other_id
342	            acc.count += 1
343	        }
344	    }
345	    return .EPILOG_NEXT
346	}
347	
348	_arrow_color_for_tag :: proc(tag: string) -> rl.Color {
349	    switch tag {
350	    case "crush", "crushing": return rl.Color{255, 150, 180, 200}  // pink
351	    case "friend":            return rl.Color{80,  200, 80,  200}  // green
352	    case "acquaintance":      return rl.Color{60,  180, 180, 200}  // teal
353	    case "sibling":           return rl.Color{80,  120, 240, 200}  // blue
354	    case "partner":           return rl.Color{220, 180, 255, 200}  // lavender
355	    case "rivals":            return rl.Color{220, 60,  60,  200}  // red
356	    }
357	    return rl.Color{200, 200, 60, 140}  // default yellow
358	}
359	
360	_draw_hover_arrows :: proc(app: ^App, hovered_char: ^Character) {
361	    buf_id, goal_buf: [160]u8
362	    atom := character_atom(hovered_char.id, buf_id[:])
363	
364	    // Query relationship/3 for typed arrows
365	    gs := fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "relationship(%s, Other, Tag)", atom)
366	    goal_buf[len(gs)] = 0
367	
368	    rel_acc := _HoverRelAccum{}
369	    epilog_query(app.engine, cstring(raw_data(goal_buf[:])), _hover_rel_cb, &rel_acc)
370	
371	    // Also query crush(atom, Y) for pink arrows
372	    crush_acc := _CrushAccum{}
373	    gs2 := fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "crush(%s, Y)", atom)
374	    goal_buf[len(gs2)] = 0
375	    epilog_query(app.engine, cstring(raw_data(goal_buf[:])), _crush_cb, &crush_acc)
376	
377	    // rivals(atom, Y)
378	    rival_acc := _CrushAccum{}
379	    gs3 := fmt.bprintf(goal_buf[:], "rivals(%s, Y)", atom)
380	    goal_buf[len(gs3)] = 0
381	    epilog_query(app.engine, cstring(raw_data(goal_buf[:])), _crush_cb, &rival_acc)
382	
383	    hx, hy, hv := _grid_to_screen(hovered_char.position[0], hovered_char.position[1],
384	                                   app.cam_col, app.cam_row, sim_w(), sim_h())
385	    if !hv do return
386	
387	    cpx := render_cell_px()
388	    cx  := hx + cpx/2
389	    cy  := hy + cpx/2
390	
391	    // Draw relationship arrows
392	    for i in 0..<rel_acc.count {
393	        e := &rel_acc.entries[i]
394	        other := residents_find(&app.residents, e.id)
395	        if other == nil do continue
396	        ox, oy, ov := _grid_to_screen(other.position[0], other.position[1],
397	                                       app.cam_col, app.cam_row, sim_w(), sim_h())
398	        if !ov do continue
399	        tag_str := strings.truncate_to_byte(string(e.tag[:]), 0)
400	        col := _arrow_color_for_tag(tag_str)
401	        rl.DrawLine(cx, cy, ox + cpx/2, oy + cpx/2, col)
402	    }
403	
404	    // Crush arrows (pink) — may already be covered, but ensures crushes show
405	    for i in 0..<crush_acc.count {
406	        other := residents_find(&app.residents, crush_acc.ids[i])
407	        if other == nil do continue
408	        ox, oy, ov := _grid_to_screen(other.position[0], other.position[1],
409	                                       app.cam_col, app.cam_row, sim_w(), sim_h())
410	        if !ov do continue
411	        rl.DrawLine(cx, cy, ox + cpx/2, oy + cpx/2, rl.Color{255, 130, 180, 220})
412	    }
413	
414	    // Rival arrows (red dashed — approximate with two short segments)
415	    for i in 0..<rival_acc.count {
416	        other := residents_find(&app.residents, rival_acc.ids[i])
417	        if other == nil do continue
418	        ox, oy, ov := _grid_to_screen(other.position[0], other.position[1],
419	                                       app.cam_col, app.cam_row, sim_w(), sim_h())
420	        if !ov do continue
421	        // Dashed: draw 3 segments
422	        dx := (ox + cpx/2) - cx
423	        dy := (oy + cpx/2) - cy
424	        for seg in 0..<3 {
425	            t0 := f32(seg) / 5.0
426	            t1 := f32(seg) / 5.0 + 0.12
427	            rl.DrawLine(cx + i32(f32(dx)*t0), cy + i32(f32(dy)*t0),
428	                        cx + i32(f32(dx)*t1), cy + i32(f32(dy)*t1),
429	                        rl.Color{220, 50, 50, 220})
430	        }
431	    }
432	}

434	// ---- Draw simulation view into sim_tex (60 fps) ----------------------------
435	
436	_draw_sim_view :: proc(app: ^App) {
437	    rl.BeginTextureMode(app.sim_tex)
438	    rl.ClearBackground(COL_BG)
439	
440	    cpx := render_cell_px()
441	    grid_render(&app.world.grid, 0, 0, sim_w(), sim_h(), app.cam_col, app.cam_row, cpx)
442	
443	    mouse          := rl.GetMousePosition()
444	    app.hovered_id  = 0
445	
446	    for i in 0..<app.residents.count {
447	        c  := &app.residents.chars[i]
448	        px, py, vis := _grid_to_screen(c.position[0], c.position[1],
449	                                        app.cam_col, app.cam_row, sim_w(), sim_h())
450	        if !vis do continue
451	
452	        col := _char_color(c)
453	        draw_char_dot_animated(c, px, py, col, app.anim_time, cpx)
454	
455	        // Mood icon above sprite
456	        ia := int(c.id - 1)
457	        if ia >= 0 && ia < MAX_RESIDENTS {
458	            draw_mood_icon(app.sim.social[ia].mood, px, py, app.anim_time, cpx)
459	        }
460	
461	        dot_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(px) - 4, f32(py) - 4,
462	                                  f32(cpx) + 8, f32(cpx) + 8}
463	        if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(mouse, dot_rect) {
464	            app.hovered_id = c.id
465	        }
466	    }
467	
468	    if app.hovered_id != 0 {
469	        hov_char := residents_find(&app.residents, app.hovered_id)
470	        if hov_char != nil {
471	            _draw_hover_arrows(app, hov_char)
472	            hx, hy, _ := _grid_to_screen(hov_char.position[0], hov_char.position[1],
473	                                           app.cam_col, app.cam_row, sim_w(), sim_h())
474	            name_cstr := strings.clone_to_cstring(character_name(hov_char), context.temp_allocator)
475	            rl.DrawText(name_cstr, hx + 6, hy - 18, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
476	            ia := int(hov_char.id - 1)
477	            if ia >= 0 && ia < MAX_RESIDENTS {
478	                mood_cstr := strings.clone_to_cstring(mood_label(app.sim.social[ia].mood), context.temp_allocator)
479	                rl.DrawText(mood_cstr, hx + 6, hy - 2, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
480	            }
481	        }
482	    }
483	
484	    // Dialogue bubbles
485	    bubble_system_draw(&app.bubbles, &app.residents, app.cam_col, app.cam_row, cpx)
486	
487	    // Weather effects (before overlay)
488	    switch app.weather.current {
489	    case .Rain: weather_draw_rain(app.anim_time, app.cam_col, app.cam_row)
490	    case .Fog:  weather_draw_fog()
491	    case .Wind: weather_draw_wind(app.anim_time, &app.world.grid, app.cam_col, app.cam_row, cpx)
492	    case .Clear: // nothing
493	    }
494	
495	    // Day / night overlay
496	    dn_col := day_night_overlay(app.world.tick, app.sim_timer)
497	    if dn_col.a > 0 {
498	        rl.DrawRectangle(0, 0, sim_w(), sim_h(), dn_col)
499	    }
500	    day_night_draw_stars(app.world.tick, app.cam_col, app.cam_row, &app.world.grid)
501	
502	    // Zone labels
503	    zone_labels_draw(&app.zone_labels, app.cam_col, app.cam_row, rl.GetFrameTime())
504	
505	    rl.DrawText("WASD: pan   hover: inspect   F5: save   F9: load   Space: pause   +/-: speed",
506	                8, sim_h() - 20, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
507	    rl.EndTextureMode()
508	}
509	
510	// ---- Colour-coded event text -----------------------------------------------
511	// Scans a string for known character names and draws each token in the
512	// character's palette colour, drawing other text in COL_TEXT.
513	
514	_draw_event_coloured :: proc(app: ^App, text: string, x, y: i32) {
515	    cx := x
516	    i  := 0
517	    for i < len(text) {
518	        // Try to match a character name at position i
519	        matched_len    := 0
520	        matched_color  := COL_TEXT
521	
522	        for ci in 0..<app.residents.count {
523	            c    := &app.residents.chars[ci]
524	            name := character_name(c)
525	            if i + len(name) <= len(text) && text[i:i+len(name)] == name {
526	                if matched_len < len(name) {
527	                    matched_len   = len(name)
528	                    matched_color = _char_color(c)
529	                }
530	            }
531	        }
532	
533	        if matched_len > 0 {
534	            seg  := strings.clone_to_cstring(text[i:i+matched_len], context.temp_allocator)
535	            rl.DrawText(seg, cx, y, UI_SMALL, matched_color)
536	            cx += rl.MeasureText(seg, UI_SMALL)
537	            i  += matched_len
538	        } else {
539	            // Advance until next potential name start or end of string
540	            j := i + 1
541	            for j < len(text) {
542	                found := false
543	                for ci in 0..<app.residents.count {
544	                    c    := &app.residents.chars[ci]
545	                    name := character_name(c)
546	                    if j + len(name) <= len(text) && text[j:j+len(name)] == name {
547	                        found = true
548	                        break
549	                    }
550	                }
551	                if found do break
552	                j += 1
553	            }
554	            seg  := strings.clone_to_cstring(text[i:j], context.temp_allocator)
555	            rl.DrawText(seg, cx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
556	            cx += rl.MeasureText(seg, UI_SMALL)
557	            i   = j
558	        }
559	    }
560	}
561	
562	// ---- Draw stats sidebar into stat_tex (10 fps) ------------------------------
563	
564	_draw_stat_panel :: proc(app: ^App) {
565	    rl.BeginTextureMode(app.stat_tex)
566	    rl.ClearBackground(COL_PANEL)
567	
568	    sw := stat_w()
569	    y  := i32(UI_PAD)
570	    lx := i32(UI_PAD)
571	
572	    rl.DrawText("ISLAND STATS", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_ACCENT)
573	    y += 20
574	
575	    // Speed buttons: [▶ 1×]  [▶▶ 4×]  [▶▶▶ 16×]  [⏸]
576	    speed_labels := [4]cstring{"|| Pause", "> 1x", ">> 4x", ">>> 16x"}
577	    speed_bw := i32(56)
578	    sx := lx
579	    for si in 0..<4 {
580	        sel := app.sim_speed == si
581	        br  := rl.Rectangle{f32(sx), f32(y), f32(speed_bw), 22}
582	        bg  := sel ? COL_ACCENT : COL_INPUT
583	        hov := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), br)
584	        if hov { bg = sel ? COL_ACCENT : COL_HOVER }
585	        rl.DrawRectangleRec(br, bg)
586	        rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(br, 1, sel ? COL_ACCENT : COL_MUTED)
587	        rl.DrawText(speed_labels[si], sx + 4, y + 4, UI_SMALL - 2, COL_TEXT)
588	        sx += speed_bw + 2
589	    }
590	    y += 28
591	
592	    iname_cstr := strings.clone_to_cstring(island_name_str(&app.island_name), context.temp_allocator)
593	    rl.DrawText(iname_cstr, lx, y, UI_FSIZE, COL_TEXT)
594	    y += 24
595	
596	    seed_buf: [24]u8
597	    rl.DrawText("Seed:", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
598	    seed_cstr := world_seed_string(&app.world, seed_buf[:])
599	    rl.DrawText(seed_cstr, lx + 50, y, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
600	    y += 20
601	
602	    stat_lines: [6][56]u8
603	    sl0 := fmt.bprintf(stat_lines[0][:], "Tick:      %d", app.world.tick)
604	    stat_lines[0][len(sl0)] = 0
605	    sl1 := fmt.bprintf(stat_lines[1][:], "Residents: %d", app.residents.count)
606	    stat_lines[1][len(sl1)] = 0
607	    sl2 := fmt.bprintf(stat_lines[2][:], "Crushes:   %d", app.sim.crush_count)
608	    stat_lines[2][len(sl2)] = 0
609	    sl3 := fmt.bprintf(stat_lines[3][:], "Rivals:    %d pairs", app.sim.rival_count)
610	    stat_lines[3][len(sl3)] = 0
611	    sl4 := fmt.bprintf(stat_lines[4][:], "Weather:   %s (~%d ticks)",
612	        weather_label(app.weather.current), app.weather.ticks_remaining)
613	    stat_lines[4][len(sl4)] = 0
614	    // Day/night phase label
615	    phase_str := ""
616	    switch day_phase_for_tick(app.world.tick) {
617	    case .Dawn:  phase_str = "Dawn"
618	    case .Day:   phase_str = "Day"
619	    case .Dusk:  phase_str = "Dusk"
620	    case .Night: phase_str = "Night"
621	    }
622	    sl5 := fmt.bprintf(stat_lines[5][:], "Time:      %s", phase_str)
623	    stat_lines[5][len(sl5)] = 0
624	    for &ln in stat_lines {
625	        rl.DrawText(cstring(raw_data(ln[:])), lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
626	        y += 18
627	    }
628	    y += 8
629	
630	    rl.DrawLine(lx, y, sw - lx, y, COL_MUTED)
631	    y += 10
632	
633	    rl.DrawText("RESIDENTS", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_ACCENT)
634	    y += 20
635	
636	    for i in 0..<app.residents.count {
637	        c  := &app.residents.chars[i]
638	        ia := int(c.id - 1)
639	        rl.DrawRectangle(lx, y + 3, 10, 10, _char_color(c))
640	        name_cstr := strings.clone_to_cstring(character_name(c), context.temp_allocator)
641	        rl.DrawText(name_cstr, lx + 16, y, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
642	        if ia >= 0 && ia < MAX_RESIDENTS {
643	            mood_cstr := strings.clone_to_cstring(mood_label(app.sim.social[ia].mood), context.temp_allocator)
644	            rl.DrawText(mood_cstr, lx + 110, y, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
645	        }
646	        y += 18
647	    }
648	    if app.residents.count == 0 {
649	        rl.DrawText("none yet", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
650	        y += 18
651	    }
652	    y += 8
653	
654	    rl.DrawLine(lx, y, sw - lx, y, COL_MUTED)
655	    y += 10
656	
657	    rl.DrawText("EVENTS", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_ACCENT)
658	    y += 20
659	
660	    MAX_SHOWN :: 8
661	    shown := min(app.sim.log.count, MAX_SHOWN)
662	    if shown == 0 {
663	        rl.DrawText("no events yet", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
664	        y += 18
665	    } else {
666	        for i in 0..<shown {
667	            e := event_log_get(&app.sim.log, i)
668	            if e == nil do continue
669	            tick_buf: [20]u8
670	            ts := fmt.bprintf(tick_buf[:], "[%d] ", e.tick)
671	            tick_buf[len(ts)] = 0
672	            tw := rl.MeasureText(cstring(raw_data(tick_buf[:])), UI_SMALL)
673	            rl.DrawText(cstring(raw_data(tick_buf[:])), lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_MUTED)
674	            _draw_event_coloured(app, event_entry_str(e), lx + tw, y)
675	            y += 18
676	        }
677	    }
678	
679	    y += 8
680	    rl.DrawLine(lx, y, sw - lx, y, COL_MUTED)
681	    y += 10
682	
683	    // Minimap
684	    rl.DrawText("MAP", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_ACCENT)
685	    y += 18
686	    minimap_draw(&app.world.grid, &app.residents, lx, y)
687	    y += MINIMAP_H + 10
688	
689	    rl.DrawLine(lx, y, sw - lx, y, COL_MUTED)
690	    y += 10
691	
692	    rl.DrawText("NAVIGATE", lx, y, UI_SMALL, COL_ACCENT)
693	    y += 20
694	
695	    // "Residents" button — clicks handled in window coords by _handle_stat_clicks
696	    res_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(lx), f32(y), 160, 30}
697	    hov_res  := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), res_rect)
698	    rl.DrawRectangleRec(res_rect, hov_res ? COL_HOVER : COL_INPUT)
699	    rl.DrawText("Residents ->", lx + 8, y + 7, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
700	    y += 40
701	
702	    // Exit button inside sidebar
703	    exit_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(lx), f32(y), 120, 30}
704	    hov_exit  := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), exit_rect)
705	    rl.DrawRectangleRec(exit_rect, hov_exit ? rl.Color{180, 40, 40, 255} : rl.Color{80, 30, 30, 200})
706	    rl.DrawText("Quit", lx + 8, y + 7, UI_SMALL, COL_TEXT)
707	
708	    rl.EndTextureMode()
709	}
710	
711	// ---- Stat sidebar button clicks (window/composite coords) -------------------
712	
713	_handle_stat_clicks :: proc(app: ^App) {
714	    ox := stats_x() + i32(UI_PAD)
715	
716	    // Speed buttons at (UI_PAD + 20 + 28) from top of stat panel
717	    speed_y    := i32(UI_PAD) + 20 + 0   // ISLAND STATS header + 20
718	    speed_bw   := i32(56)
719	    for si in 0..<4 {
720	        br := rl.Rectangle{f32(ox + i32(si) * (speed_bw + 2)), f32(speed_y), f32(speed_bw), 22}
721	        if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), br) &&
722	           rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
723	            app.sim_speed = si
724	        }
725	    }
726	
727	    res_rows  := i32(app.residents.count)
728	    res_empty := app.residents.count == 0 ? i32(18) : i32(0)
729	    evt_shown := i32(min(app.sim.log.count, 8))
730	    evt_empty := app.sim.log.count == 0 ? i32(18) : i32(0)
731	
732	    // Reconstruct y position of the Residents → button (must match _draw_stat_panel layout)
733	    // Now has extra 28px for speed buttons row, 2 extra stat lines, and minimap block
734	    base_y := i32(UI_PAD) +
735	        i32(20 + 28 + 24 + 20 + 18*6 + 8) +   // ISLAND STATS block (speed row + 6 stat lines)
736	        i32(10 + 20) +                           // divider + RESIDENTS header
737	        i32(18)*res_rows + res_empty + i32(8) +
738	        i32(10 + 10 + 20) +                      // divider + EVENTS header
739	        i32(18)*evt_shown + evt_empty + i32(8) +
740	        i32(10 + 18 + MINIMAP_H + 10 + 10 + 10 + 20)  // MAP section + divider + NAVIGATE header
741	
742	    // Resident rows in the sidebar (for backstory on click)
743	    res_list_y := i32(UI_PAD) + 20 + 28 + 24 + 20 + 18*6 + 8 + 10 + 20
744	    for i in 0..<app.residents.count {
745	        row_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(ox), f32(res_list_y + i32(i)*18), 200, 18}
746	        if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), row_rect) &&
747	           rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
748	            backstory_open(&app.backstory, app.residents.chars[i].id,
749	                           &app.residents, app.engine)
750	        }
751	    }
752	
753	    res_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(ox), f32(base_y), 160, 30}
754	    if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), res_rect) &&
755	       rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
756	        app.screen = .Residents
757	        app.resident_list = {}
758	    }
759	
760	    exit_y    := base_y + 40
761	    exit_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(ox), f32(exit_y), 120, 30}
762	    if rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), exit_rect) &&
763	       rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT) {
764	        rl.CloseWindow()
765	    }
766	}
767	
768	// ---- Cutscene check — trigger when new event appears -----------------------
769	
770	_last_event_count: int
771	
772	_check_cutscene :: proc(app: ^App) {
773	    if app.sim.log.count > _last_event_count {
774	        e := event_log_get(&app.sim.log, 0)
775	        if e != nil {
776	            cutscene_trigger(&app.cutscene, event_entry_str(e))
777	        }
778	        _last_event_count = app.sim.log.count
779	    }
780	}
781	
782	// ---- Simulation update + composite -----------------------------------------
783	
784	_update_simulation :: proc(app: ^App) {
785	    dt := rl.GetFrameTime()
786	    app.anim_time += dt
787	
788	    // ESC → quit
789	    if rl.IsKeyPressed(.ESCAPE) {
790	        rl.CloseWindow()
791	        return
792	    }
793	
794	    // WASD pan
795	    if rl.IsKeyDown(.W) { app.cam_row -= 2 }
796	    if rl.IsKeyDown(.S) { app.cam_row += 2 }
797	    if rl.IsKeyDown(.A) { app.cam_col -= 2 }
798	    if rl.IsKeyDown(.D) { app.cam_col += 2 }
799	    app.cam_col = clamp(app.cam_col, 0, GRID_W - 1)
800	    app.cam_row = clamp(app.cam_row, 0, GRID_H - 1)
801	
802	    // F5 = save, F9 = load
803	    if rl.IsKeyPressed(.F5) {
804	        _do_save(app)
805	    }
806	    if rl.IsKeyPressed(.F9) {
807	        if _do_load(app) {
808	            _draw_stat_panel(app)
809	        }
810	    }
811	
812	    // Speed keyboard shortcuts
813	    if rl.IsKeyPressed(.SPACE) {
814	        if app.sim_speed == 0 { app.sim_speed = 1 } else { app.sim_speed = 0 }
815	    }
816	    if rl.IsKeyPressed(.KP_ADD) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.EQUAL) {
817	        if app.sim_speed < 3 { app.sim_speed += 1 }
818	    }
819	    if rl.IsKeyPressed(.KP_SUBTRACT) || rl.IsKeyPressed(.MINUS) {
820	        if app.sim_speed > 1 { app.sim_speed -= 1 }
821	    }
822	
823	    // Sim tick — rate depends on sim_speed
824	    // Speed 0=paused, 1=1Hz, 2=4Hz, 3=16Hz
825	    _SPEED_HZ := [4]f32{0, 1.0, 4.0, 16.0}
826	    tick_hz := _SPEED_HZ[app.sim_speed]
827	    tick_interval := tick_hz > 0 ? 1.0 / tick_hz : 1e9
828	
829	    app.sim_timer += dt
830	    for app.sim_speed > 0 && app.sim_timer >= tick_interval {
831	        app.sim_timer -= tick_interval
832	        world_tick_wander(&app.world, &app.residents)
833	        sim_tick(&app.sim, &app.residents, app.engine, app.world.tick)
834	        weather_tick(&app.weather, &app.sim.rng)
835	        friendship_decay_tick(&app.decay, &app.residents, app.engine, &app.sim, app.world.tick)
836	        confession_tick(&app.confession, &app.sim, &app.residents, app.engine, app.world.tick)
837	        confrontation_tick(&app.confrontation, &app.sim, &app.residents, app.engine, app.world.tick)
838	        _check_cutscene(app)
839	
840	        // Auto-save every 60 ticks
841	        if app.world.tick - app.last_autosave_tick >= 60 {
842	            _do_save(app)
843	            app.last_autosave_tick = app.world.tick
844	        }
845	    }
846	
847	    // Redraw at appropriate rates
848	    _draw_sim_view(app)
849	    app.stat_timer += dt
850	    if app.stat_timer >= STAT_RATE {
851	        app.stat_timer = 0
852	        _draw_stat_panel(app)
853	    }
854	
855	    // Composite — 80/20 side-by-side
856	    rl.ClearBackground(rl.BLACK)
857	
858	    // Left: grid (80%)
859	    src_sim := rl.Rectangle{0, 0, f32(sim_w()), -f32(sim_h())}
860	    dst_sim := rl.Rectangle{0, 0, f32(sim_w()),  f32(sim_h())}
861	    rl.DrawTexturePro(app.sim_tex.texture, src_sim, dst_sim, {0, 0}, 0, rl.WHITE)
862	
863	    // Right: sidebar (20%)
864	    src_stat := rl.Rectangle{0, 0, f32(stat_w()), -f32(stat_h())}
865	    dst_stat := rl.Rectangle{f32(stats_x()), 0, f32(stat_w()), f32(stat_h())}
866	    rl.DrawTexturePro(app.stat_tex.texture, src_stat, dst_stat, {0, 0}, 0, rl.WHITE)
867	
868	    // Dividing line
869	    rl.DrawLine(stats_x(), 0, stats_x(), SH(), COL_MUTED)
870	
871	    _handle_stat_clicks(app)
872	
873	    // Tier 3: update bubbles + draw prompts
874	    bubble_system_update(&app.bubbles, dt)
875	    // Note: bubbles are drawn inside _draw_sim_view pass already via the
876	    // bubble_system_draw call — we just update timing here.
877	
878	    // Confession prompt
879	    if app.confession.state == .Waiting {
880	        conf_res := confession_draw_prompt(&app.confession, &app.residents, dt)
881	        if conf_res != 0 {
882	            confession_resolve(&app.confession, conf_res, &app.sim, &app.residents,
883	                               app.engine, app.world.tick)
884	        } else if app.confession.timer <= 0 {
885	            confession_resolve(&app.confession, 0, &app.sim, &app.residents,
886	                               app.engine, app.world.tick)
887	        }
888	    }
889	
890	    // Confrontation prompt
891	    if app.confrontation.state == .Waiting {
892	        res2 := confrontation_draw_prompt(&app.confrontation, &app.residents, dt)
893	        if res2 != 0 {
894	            confrontation_resolve(res2, app.confrontation.char_a, app.confrontation.char_b,
895	                                   &app.sim, &app.residents, app.engine, app.world.tick)
896	        }
897	    }
898	
899	    // Backstory panel (drawn on top of everything)
900	    backstory_draw(&app.backstory, &app.residents, &app.sim, &app.sim.log)
901	
902	    // M8 cutscene overlay on top of everything
903	    cutscene_update(&app.cutscene)
904	}

906	// ---- Main ------------------------------------------------------------------
907	
908	main :: proc() {
909	    rl.SetConfigFlags({.WINDOW_RESIZABLE})
910	    g_screen.w = SCREEN_W
911	    g_screen.h = SCREEN_H
912	    rl.InitWindow(SCREEN_W, SCREEN_H, "DMLS — Deb's Minimal Life Simulator")
913	    rl.SetTargetFPS(60)
914	    defer rl.CloseWindow()
915	
916	    app := new(App)
917	    defer free(app)
918	
919	    app.engine = epilog_create()
920	    defer epilog_destroy(app.engine)
921	
922	    residents_init(&app.residents)
923	    app.screen    = .Resolution
924	    app.cam_col   = GRID_W / 2
925	    app.cam_row   = GRID_H / 2
926	    app.title_rng = 0xFEEDBEEF_CAFEBABE
927	    app.sim_speed = 1
928	    weather_init(&app.weather)
929	    g_decay   = &app.decay
930	    g_bubbles = &app.bubbles
931	
932	    {
933	        def := _default_seed()
934	        ds  := fmt.bprintf(app.seed_field.buf[:], "%016X", def)
935	        app.seed_field.len = len(ds)
936	        app.seed_field.active = true

17	// ============================================================
18	// 3.1  Dialogue Bubbles
19	// ============================================================
20	
21	MAX_BUBBLES :: 8
22	
23	DialogueBubble :: struct {
24	    char_id : u32,
25	    msg     : [48]u8,
26	    msg_len : int,
27	    timer   : f32,       // seconds remaining
28	}
29	
30	BubbleSystem :: struct {
31	    bubbles : [MAX_BUBBLES]DialogueBubble,
32	    count   : int,
33	}
34	
35	_FRIEND_LINES := []string{
36	    "Did you eat today?",
37	    "I found something interesting.",
38	    "Walk with me?",
39	    "Good to see you.",
40	}
41	
42	_CRUSH_LINES := []string{
43	    "Oh— hi.",
44	    "...",
45	    "Hey.",
46	    "You look nice today.",
47	}
48	
49	_RIVAL_LINES := []string{""}  // rivals don't speak — just a pause
50	
51	_NICK_LINES := []string{
52	    "Sunflower.",
53	    "Hey, sunflower.",
54	    "There you are.",
55	}
56	
57	_ACQUAINTANCE_LINES := []string{
58	    "Hey.",
59	    "Oh, it's you.",
60	    "Hi.",
61	}
62	
63	_bubble_push :: proc(bs: ^BubbleSystem, id: u32, msg: string) {
64	    // Replace existing bubble for same char if any
65	    for i in 0..<bs.count {
66	        if bs.bubbles[i].char_id == id {
67	            b := &bs.bubbles[i]
68	            b.timer = 3.0
69	            n := min(len(msg), 47)
70	            copy(b.msg[:], msg[:n])
71	            b.msg[n] = 0
72	            b.msg_len = n
73	            return
74	        }
75	    }
76	    if bs.count >= MAX_BUBBLES do return
77	    b := &bs.bubbles[bs.count]
78	    b.char_id = id
79	    b.timer   = 3.0
80	    n := min(len(msg), 47)
81	    copy(b.msg[:], msg[:n])
82	    b.msg[n] = 0
83	    b.msg_len = n
84	    bs.count += 1
85	}
86	
87	bubble_system_update :: proc(bs: ^BubbleSystem, dt: f32) {
88	    i := 0
89	    for i < bs.count {
90	        bs.bubbles[i].timer -= dt
91	        if bs.bubbles[i].timer <= 0 {
92	            bs.bubbles[i] = bs.bubbles[bs.count-1]
93	            bs.count -= 1
94	        } else {
95	            i += 1
96	        }
97	    }
98	}
99	
100	// Call when two characters interact (proximity tick).
101	// relationship: "friend", "acquaintance", "crush", "stranger", etc.
102	bubble_on_interact :: proc(bs: ^BubbleSystem, a, b: ^Character,
103	                           relationship: string, rng: ^DependentRNG) {
104	    lines: []string
105	    switch relationship {
106	    case "friend":       lines = _FRIEND_LINES
107	    case "crush":        lines = _CRUSH_LINES
108	    case "acquaintance": lines = _ACQUAINTANCE_LINES
109	    case:                return  // strangers don't speak
110	    }
111	    if len(lines) == 0 do return
112	    idx  := int(dependent_next(rng) * f64(len(lines))) % len(lines)
113	    _bubble_push(bs, a.id, lines[idx])
114	}

147	// ============================================================
148	// 3.2  Crush Confession Event
149	// ============================================================
150	
151	ConfessionState :: enum { None, Waiting, Resolved }
152	
153	ConfessionEvent :: struct {
154	    state       : ConfessionState,
155	    from_id     : u32,
156	    on_id       : u32,
157	    timer       : f32,      // seconds before auto-resolve
158	    crush_ticks : [MAX_RESIDENTS][MAX_RESIDENTS]u64,  // tick when crush started
159	}
160	
161	confession_tick :: proc(ce: ^ConfessionEvent, sim: ^SimState, res: ^Residents,
162	                        engine: ^EpilogEngine, tick: u64) {
163	    if ce.state == .Waiting do return  // already pending player input
164	
165	    // Check all crush pairs: crush for 20+ ticks AND interaction_count > 15
166	    for i in 0..<res.count {
167	        a := &res.chars[i]
168	        ia := int(a.id - 1)
169	        if ia >= MAX_RESIDENTS || !sim.social[ia].has_crush do continue
170	
171	        // Find who they're crushing on
172	        crush_on := _find_crush_target(engine, a.id)
173	        if crush_on == 0 do continue
174	
175	        // Check ticks
176	        start_tick := ce.crush_ticks[ia][int(crush_on-1)]
177	        if start_tick == 0 {
178	            ce.crush_ticks[ia][int(crush_on-1)] = tick
179	            continue
180	        }
181	        if tick - start_tick < 20 do continue
182	        if sim.social[ia].interaction_count < 15 do continue
183	
184	        // Fire confession
185	        ce.state   = .Waiting
186	        ce.from_id = a.id
187	        ce.on_id   = crush_on
188	        ce.timer   = 10.0
189	
190	        // Log the approach
191	        b := residents_find(res, crush_on)
192	        if b != nil {
193	            msg_buf: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
194	            ms := fmt.bprintf(msg_buf[:], "%s: \"I have something to tell you.\"",
195	                character_name(a))
196	            event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg_buf[:len(ms)]))
197	        }
198	        return
199	    }
200	}
201	
202	_find_crush_target :: proc(engine: ^EpilogEngine, from_id: u32) -> u32 {
203	    buf_a, goal: [128]u8
204	    atom_a := character_atom(from_id, buf_a[:])
205	
206	    result := u32(0)
207	
208	    CrushTargetCB :: struct { target: u32 }
209	    cb_data := CrushTargetCB{}
210	
211	    crush_target_cb :: proc "c" (soln: ^EpilogSolution, ud: rawptr) -> EpilogSignal {
212	        data := cast(^CrushTargetCB)ud
213	        for i in 0..<epilog_soln_var_count(soln) {
214	            vname := epilog_soln_var_name(soln, i)
215	            val   := epilog_soln_var_atom(soln, i)
216	            if vname == nil || val == nil do continue
217	            if string(vname) == "Y" {
218	                s := string(val)
219	                if len(s) > 5 && s[:5] == "char_" {
220	                    id := u32(0)
221	                    for ch in s[5:] {
222	                        if ch >= '0' && ch <= '9' { id = id*10 + u32(ch-'0') }
223	                    }
224	                    data.target = id
225	                }
226	            }
227	        }
228	        return .EPILOG_STOP
229	    }
230	
231	    gs := fmt.bprintf(goal[:], "crush(%s, Y)", atom_a)
232	    goal[len(gs)] = 0
233	    epilog_query(engine, cstring(raw_data(goal[:])), crush_target_cb, &cb_data)
234	    result = cb_data.target
235	    return result
236	}
237	
238	// Call every frame when state == .Waiting — draws the prompt.
239	// Returns: 0=still waiting, 1=accepted, 2=rejected
240	confession_draw_prompt :: proc(ce: ^ConfessionEvent, res: ^Residents, dt: f32) -> int {
241	    if ce.state != .Waiting do return 0
242	
243	    ce.timer -= dt
244	    from := residents_find(res, ce.from_id)
245	    on   := residents_find(res, ce.on_id)
246	    if from == nil || on == nil { ce.state = .None; return 0 }
247	
248	    // Overlay
249	    rl.DrawRectangle(0, 0, SW(), SH(), rl.Color{10, 10, 20, 160})
250	
251	    cw := i32(480)
252	    ch := i32(140)
253	    cx := (SW() - cw) / 2
254	    cy := (SH() - ch) / 2
255	    rl.DrawRectangle(cx, cy, cw, ch, rl.Color{30, 28, 50, 240})
256	    rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rl.Rectangle{f32(cx), f32(cy), f32(cw), f32(ch)},
257	                             2, rl.Color{255, 130, 180, 200})
258	
259	    // Names in their colours
260	    from_name := strings.clone_to_cstring(character_name(from), context.temp_allocator)
261	    on_name   := strings.clone_to_cstring(character_name(on),   context.temp_allocator)
262	    rl.DrawText(from_name, cx + 20, cy + 16, UI_FSIZE, char_palette_color(from.sprite))
263	    rl.DrawText(" confesses to ", cx + 20 + rl.MeasureText(from_name, UI_FSIZE), cy + 16, UI_FSIZE, COL_TEXT)
264	    rl.DrawText(on_name, cx + 20 + rl.MeasureText(from_name, UI_FSIZE) +
265	                rl.MeasureText(" confesses to ", UI_FSIZE), cy + 16, UI_FSIZE, char_palette_color(on.sprite))
266	
267	    // Timer bar
268	    bar_w := i32(f32(cw - 40) * (ce.timer / 10.0))
269	    rl.DrawRectangle(cx + 20, cy + 46, cw - 40, 4, COL_MUTED)
270	    rl.DrawRectangle(cx + 20, cy + 46, bar_w, 4, rl.Color{255, 130, 180, 255})
271	
272	    // Buttons
273	    acc_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(cx + 60), f32(cy + 70), 140, 44}
274	    rej_rect := rl.Rectangle{f32(cx + 280), f32(cy + 70), 140, 44}
275	    hov_acc  := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), acc_rect)
276	    hov_rej  := rl.CheckCollisionPointRec(rl.GetMousePosition(), rej_rect)
277	    rl.DrawRectangleRec(acc_rect, hov_acc ? COL_CONFIRM : rl.Color{40, 120, 70, 255})
278	    rl.DrawRectangleRec(rej_rect, hov_rej ? COL_ACCENT2 : rl.Color{120, 40, 60, 255})
279	    rl.DrawText("Accept", cx + 84, cy + 82, UI_FSIZE, COL_TEXT)
280	    rl.DrawText("Reject", cx + 304, cy + 82, UI_FSIZE, COL_TEXT)
281	
282	    if (hov_acc && rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT)) {
283	        ce.state = .Resolved; return 1
284	    }
285	    if (hov_rej && rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(.LEFT)) {
286	        ce.state = .Resolved; return 2
287	    }
288	
289	    // Auto-resolve after 10 seconds based on target's mood
290	    if ce.timer <= 0 {
291	        ce.state = .Resolved
292	        on_idx := int(on.id - 1)
293	        // (caller will resolve based on mood — return 0 means timer expired)
294	        return 0
295	    }
296	    return 0
297	}

299	confession_resolve :: proc(ce: ^ConfessionEvent, result: int,
300	                            sim: ^SimState, res: ^Residents,
301	                            engine: ^EpilogEngine, tick: u64) {
302	    from := residents_find(res, ce.from_id)
303	    on   := residents_find(res, ce.on_id)
304	    if from == nil || on == nil do return
305	
306	    buf_a, buf_b, src: [256]u8
307	    atom_a := character_atom(ce.from_id, buf_a[:])
308	    atom_b := character_atom(ce.on_id,   buf_b[:])
309	
310	    accepted := result == 1
311	    if result == 0 {
312	        // Auto-resolve by mood
313	        on_idx := int(on.id - 1)
314	        m := on_idx >= 0 && on_idx < MAX_RESIDENTS ? sim.social[on_idx].mood : Mood.Content
315	        accepted = m == .Lovestruck || (m == .Content && sim.rng.state & 1 == 0)
316	    }
317	
318	    if accepted {
319	        // Assert partner relationship
320	        s := fmt.bprintf(src[:], "partner(%s, %s).", atom_a, atom_b)
321	        src[len(s)] = 0
322	        epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(src[:])))
323	        s = fmt.bprintf(src[:], "partner(%s, %s).", atom_b, atom_a)
324	        src[len(s)] = 0
325	        epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(src[:])))
326	
327	        ia := int(from.id - 1)
328	        ib := int(on.id - 1)
329	        if ia >= 0 && ia < MAX_RESIDENTS { sim.social[ia].mood = .Happy }
330	        if ib >= 0 && ib < MAX_RESIDENTS { sim.social[ib].mood = .Happy }
331	
332	        msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
333	        ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "%s and %s are now partners",
334	            character_name(from), character_name(on))
335	        event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
336	    } else {
337	        // Retract crush (mark as no crush)
338	        ia := int(from.id - 1)
339	        ib := int(on.id - 1)
340	        if ia >= 0 && ia < MAX_RESIDENTS {
341	            sim.social[ia].has_crush = false
342	            sim.social[ia].mood = .Sad
343	        }
344	        if ib >= 0 && ib < MAX_RESIDENTS { sim.social[ib].mood = .Content }
345	
346	        msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
347	        ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "%s was rejected by %s",
348	            character_name(from), character_name(on))
349	        event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
350	    }
351	    ce.state = .None
352	}

354	// ============================================================
355	// 3.3  Rival Confrontation Event
356	// ============================================================
357	
358	ConfrontationState :: enum { None, Waiting }
359	
360	ConfrontationEvent :: struct {
361	    state    : ConfrontationState,
362	    char_a   : u32,
363	    char_b   : u32,
364	    timer    : f32,
365	    cooldown : [MAX_RESIDENTS][MAX_RESIDENTS]u64,
366	}
367	
368	CONFRONT_DIST     :: 5
369	CONFRONT_MIN_TICK :: 30
370	
371	confrontation_tick :: proc(ce: ^ConfrontationEvent, sim: ^SimState,
372	                            res: ^Residents, engine: ^EpilogEngine, tick: u64) {
373	    if ce.state == .Waiting do return
374	
375	    for i in 0..<res.count {
376	        for j in i+1..<res.count {
377	            a := &res.chars[i]
378	            b := &res.chars[j]
379	            ia := int(a.id - 1)
380	            ib := int(b.id - 1)
381	            if ia >= MAX_RESIDENTS || ib >= MAX_RESIDENTS do continue
382	
383	            // Check cooldown
384	            if ce.cooldown[ia][ib] + CONFRONT_MIN_TICK > tick do continue
385	
386	            // Check rivals
387	            buf_a, buf_b2, goal: [128]u8
388	            atom_a := character_atom(a.id, buf_a[:])
389	            atom_b := character_atom(b.id, buf_b2[:])
390	            gs := fmt.bprintf(goal[:], "rivals(%s, %s)", atom_a, atom_b)
391	            goal[len(gs)] = 0
392	            if !_epilog_bool(engine, string(goal[:len(gs)])) do continue
393	
394	            // Check proximity
395	            dx := a.position[0] - b.position[0]
396	            dy := a.position[1] - b.position[1]
397	            if dx < 0 { dx = -dx }
398	            if dy < 0 { dy = -dy }
399	            if dx + dy > CONFRONT_DIST do continue
400	
401	            // Fire confrontation
402	            ce.state  = .Waiting
403	            ce.char_a = a.id
404	            ce.char_b = b.id
405	            ce.timer  = 15.0
406	            ce.cooldown[ia][ib] = tick
407	            ce.cooldown[ib][ia] = tick
408	
409	            msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
410	            ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "%s and %s face each other",
411	                character_name(a), character_name(b))
412	            event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
413	            return
414	        }
415	    }
416	}
417

465	confrontation_resolve :: proc(result: int, char_a, char_b: u32,
466	                               sim: ^SimState, res: ^Residents,
467	                               engine: ^EpilogEngine, tick: u64) {
468	    a := residents_find(res, char_a)
469	    b := residents_find(res, char_b)
470	    if a == nil || b == nil do return
471	
472	    ia := int(char_a - 1)
473	    ib := int(char_b - 1)
474	
475	    if result == 1 {
476	        // Let it happen — one dominates
477	        winner_is_a := sim.rng.state & 1 == 0
478	        dom_id  := winner_is_a ? char_a : char_b
479	        sub_idx := winner_is_a ? ib : ia
480	
481	        buf: [256]u8
482	        atom := character_atom(dom_id, buf[:])
483	        s := fmt.bprintf(buf[32:], "dominant_rival(%s).", atom)
484	        buf[32+len(s)] = 0
485	        epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(buf[32:])))
486	
487	        if sub_idx >= 0 && sub_idx < MAX_RESIDENTS {
488	            sim.social[sub_idx].mood = .Sad
489	        }
490	        dom_char := residents_find(res, dom_id)
491	        if dom_char != nil {
492	            msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
493	            ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "%s emerged dominant from the confrontation",
494	                character_name(dom_char))
495	            event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
496	        }
497	    } else {
498	        // Intervene — both reset to content, cooldown already set
499	        if ia >= 0 && ia < MAX_RESIDENTS { sim.social[ia].mood = .Content }
500	        if ib >= 0 && ib < MAX_RESIDENTS { sim.social[ib].mood = .Content }
501	
502	        msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
503	        ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "Confrontation between %s and %s was defused",
504	            character_name(a), character_name(b))
505	        event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
506	    }
507	}

509	// ============================================================
510	// 3.4  Friendship Decay
511	// ============================================================
512	// Track last-interaction tick per pair. Decay friend→acquaintance
513	// if no interaction in 30 ticks, acquaintance→stranger in 50.
514	
515	FriendshipDecay :: struct {
516	    last_interact : [MAX_RESIDENTS][MAX_RESIDENTS]u64,
517	}
518	
519	friendship_decay_record :: proc(fd: ^FriendshipDecay, id_a, id_b: u32, tick: u64) {
520	    ia := int(id_a - 1)
521	    ib := int(id_b - 1)
522	    if ia >= MAX_RESIDENTS || ib >= MAX_RESIDENTS do return
523	    fd.last_interact[ia][ib] = tick
524	    fd.last_interact[ib][ia] = tick
525	}
526	
527	friendship_decay_tick :: proc(fd: ^FriendshipDecay, res: ^Residents,
528	                               engine: ^EpilogEngine, sim: ^SimState, tick: u64) {
529	    buf_a, buf_b, src: [256]u8
530	
531	    for i in 0..<res.count {
532	        for j in i+1..<res.count {
533	            a := &res.chars[i]
534	            b := &res.chars[j]
535	            ia := int(a.id - 1)
536	            ib := int(b.id - 1)
537	            if ia >= MAX_RESIDENTS || ib >= MAX_RESIDENTS do continue
538	
539	            last := fd.last_interact[ia][ib]
540	            if last == 0 do continue
541	
542	            idle := tick - last
543	
544	            // Query current relationship
545	            atom_a := character_atom(a.id, buf_a[:])
546	            atom_b := character_atom(b.id, buf_b[:])
547	
548	            // Check friend decay (30 ticks idle)
549	            if idle == 30 {
550	                gs := fmt.bprintf(src[:], "friend(%s, %s)", atom_a, atom_b)
551	                src[len(gs)] = 0
552	                if _epilog_bool(engine, string(src[:len(gs)])) {
553	                    // Downgrade to acquaintance
554	                    s := fmt.bprintf(src[:], "acquaintance(%s, %s).", atom_a, atom_b)
555	                    src[len(s)] = 0
556	                    epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(src[:])))
557	                    s = fmt.bprintf(src[:], "acquaintance(%s, %s).", atom_b, atom_a)
558	                    src[len(s)] = 0
559	                    epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(src[:])))
560	
561	                    msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
562	                    ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "%s and %s drifted apart (friend -> acquaintance)",
563	                        character_name(a), character_name(b))
564	                    event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
565	                }
566	            }
567	
568	            // Check acquaintance decay (50 ticks idle)
569	            if idle == 50 {
570	                gs := fmt.bprintf(src[:], "acquaintance(%s, %s)", atom_a, atom_b)
571	                src[len(gs)] = 0
572	                if _epilog_bool(engine, string(src[:len(gs)])) {
573	                    s := fmt.bprintf(src[:], "stranger(%s, %s).", atom_a, atom_b)
574	                    src[len(s)] = 0
575	                    epilog_load_string(engine, cstring(raw_data(src[:])))
576	
577	                    msg: [EVENT_MSG_LEN]u8
578	                    ms := fmt.bprintf(msg[:], "%s and %s became strangers (acquaintance -> stranger)",
579	                        character_name(a), character_name(b))
580	                    event_log_push(&sim.log, tick, string(msg[:len(ms)]))
581	                }
582	            }
583	        }
584	    }
585	}

30	    c := residents_find(res, id)
31	    if c == nil do return false
32	
33	    col, row, ok := grid_find_spawn(&w.grid, &w.rng)
34	    if !ok do return false
35	
36	    if !grid_place_character(&w.grid, id, col, row) do return false
37	
38	    c.position = {col, row}
39	    idx := id - 1
40	    if int(idx) < MAX_RESIDENTS {
41	        w.positions[idx] = {col, row}
42	    }
43	    return true
44	}

49	    dy := [4]i32{1, -1, 0, 0}

54	        row := c.position[1]

56	        // Pick a random direction
57	        w.rng = w.rng * 6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
58	        dir  := int((w.rng >> 33) % 4)
59

# Material Design 3

This skill guides implementation of Google's Material Design 3 (MD3) — a personal, adaptive, expressive design system. MD3 uses dynamic color, tonal surfaces, rounded shapes, and spring-based motion to create UIs that feel alive and personal.

## Philosophy

MD3 is built on three principles:
- **Personal**: Dynamic color adapts UI to the user's wallpaper or content. Theming is individual, not one-size-fits-all.
- **Adaptive**: Layouts transform across 5 window size classes. Components resize, reposition, and change form factor responsively.
- **Expressive**: Shape morphing, spring physics, and emphasized typography create moments of delight without sacrificing usability.

## Current Updates: Google I/O 2026

Material's [Google I/O 2026 update](https://m3.material.io/blog/whats-new-at-io26) reinforces a **Compose-first** Android path and expands expressive/adaptive guidance:

- **Material Android is Compose-first**: For new Android work, prefer Jetpack Compose Material3 for the latest components, expressive APIs, adaptive scaffolds, and Styles API integration. Android Views may remain necessary in existing apps, but they should not be treated as the default path for new Material 3 implementations.
- **Expressive layout system**: Use an expressive layout scaffold to adapt screens across mobile, desktop, foldables, watches, XR, and other spatial form factors. Start from adaptive scaffolds/window size classes instead of fixed phone-first layouts.
- **8dp spacing system**: Apply spacing tokens for margins, padding, and gaps so layouts and components can adapt programmatically to device type and density.
- **New/updated expressive components**: Lists, menus, search, and search app bars have refreshed expressive guidance, with Jetpack Compose as the primary implementation target.
- **Watches and XR**: Watches emphasize physics-based motion, arc text, and edge-hugging containers. XR emphasizes spatial panels and depth-based elevation.

**Key differences from MD2:**
- Tonal surfaces replace elevation shadows as the primary depth cue
- Dynamic color generates full schemes from a single seed color
- Fully rounded corners by default (not slightly rounded)
- Spring-based motion physics replace fixed easing curves for components
- 3 levels of user-controlled contrast (standard/medium/high)

**Relationship with frontend-design skill:**
When both skills are active, MD3 provides the design system (tokens, components, layout rules) and frontend-design provides creative direction within those constraints. MD3 rules take precedence for component structure and token usage. Note: Roboto/Roboto Flex IS the correct default typeface in MD3 — the frontend-design guidance to avoid Roboto does not apply when implementing MD3.

## Decision Tree

**What are you building?**
```
Full app scaffold        → See "Common Patterns: App Shell" + references/layout-and-responsive.md
Single component         → See "Component Quick Reference" table → references/component-catalog.md
Custom theme             → See references/theming-and-dynamic-color.md
Form / input layout      → See references/component-catalog.md § Input Components
Navigation structure     → See references/navigation-patterns.md
Data display             → See references/component-catalog.md § Data Display
```

**What platform?**
```
Jetpack Compose          → Primary: androidx.compose.material3, MaterialTheme, references/*
Flutter                  → useMaterial3: true in ThemeData, ColorScheme.fromSeed()
Web (vanilla JS)         → @material/web (limited; maintenance mode) + CSS custom properties
Web (React/Vue/Svelte)   → CSS custom properties + wrapper components (no official React lib)
Web (CSS-only)           → MD3 token values as CSS custom properties (no <md-*> elements)
```

## Design Token System

All MD3 tokens use the `md.sys` namespace. **Jetpack Compose** maps roles to `MaterialTheme.colorScheme`, `MaterialTheme.typography`, and `MaterialTheme.shapes` (same semantic roles as the spec). **On the web**, these map to CSS custom properties (`--md-sys-*`):

### Color Tokens (`--md-sys-color-*`)
| Token | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `primary` | High-emphasis fills, text, icons against surface |
| `on-primary` | Text/icons on primary |
| `primary-container` | Standout fill for key components (FAB, etc.) |
| `on-primary-container` | Text/icons on primary-container |
| `secondary` / `on-secondary` | Less prominent accents |
| `secondary-container` / `on-secondary-container` | Recessive components (tonal buttons) |
| `tertiary` / `on-tertiary` | Contrasting accents |
| `tertiary-container` / `on-tertiary-container` | Complementary containers |
| `error` / `on-error` | Error states (static — doesn't change with dynamic color) |
| `error-container` / `on-error-container` | Error container fills |
| `surface` | Default background |
| `on-surface` | Text/icons on any surface |
| `on-surface-variant` | Lower-emphasis text/icons on surface |
| `surface-container-lowest` | Lowest-emphasis container |
| `surface-container-low` | Low-emphasis container |
| `surface-container` | Default container (nav areas) |
| `surface-container-high` | High-emphasis container |
| `surface-container-highest` | Highest-emphasis container |
| `surface-dim` / `surface-bright` | Maintain relative brightness across light/dark |
| `inverse-surface` / `inverse-on-surface` / `inverse-primary` | Contrasting elements (snackbars) |
| `outline` | Important boundaries (text field borders) |
| `outline-variant` | Decorative elements (dividers) |

Full details: `references/color-system.md`

### Typography Tokens (`--md-sys-typescale-*`)
| Scale | Sizes | Use |
|-------|-------|-----|
| Display | L / M / S | Hero text, large numbers |
| Headline | L / M / S | Section headers |
| Title | L / M / S | Smaller headers, card titles |
| Body | L / M / S | Paragraph text, descriptions |
| Label | L / M / S | Buttons, chips, captions |

Each style has tokens for: `-font`, `-weight`, `-size`, `-line-height`, `-tracking`
Plus 15 **emphasized** variants (higher weight) via `--md-sys-typescale-emphasized-*`

Full details: `references/typography-and-shape.md`

### Shape Tokens (`--md-sys-shape-corner-*`)
| Token | Value | Example components |
|-------|-------|-------------------|
| `none` | 0dp | — |
| `extra-small` | 4dp | Chips, snackbars |
| `small` | 8dp | Text fields, menus |
| `medium` | 12dp | Cards |
| `large` | 16dp | FABs, navigation drawer |
| `large-increased` | 20dp | (Expressive) |
| `extra-large` | 28dp | Dialogs, bottom sheets |
| `extra-large-increased` | 32dp | (Expressive) |
| `extra-extra-large` | 48dp | (Expressive) |
| `full` | 9999px | Buttons, chips, badges |

### Elevation Levels
| Level | DP | Tonal offset | Use |
|-------|-----|-------------|-----|
| 0 | 0dp | None | Flat surfaces, most components at rest |
| 1 | 1dp | +5% primary | Elevated cards, modal sheets |
| 2 | 3dp | +8% primary | Menus, nav bar, scrolled app bar |
| 3 | 6dp | +11% primary | FAB, dialogs, search, date/time pickers |
| 4 | 8dp | +12% primary | (hover/focus increase only) |
| 5 | 12dp | +14% primary | (hover/focus increase only) |

Elevation in MD3 is communicated through **tonal surface color**, not shadows. Shadows are only used when needed for additional protection against busy backgrounds.

### Motion
MD3 Expressive (May 2025) introduced **spring-based motion physics** for components. The legacy easing/duration system is still used for **transitions** (enter/exit/shared-axis):

| Easing | Duration | Transition type |
|--------|----------|-----------------|
| Emphasized | 500ms | Begin and end on screen |
| Emphasized decelerate | 400ms | Enter the screen |
| Emphasized accelerate | 200ms | Exit the screen |
| Standard | 300ms | Begin and end on screen (utility) |
| Standard decelerate | 250ms | Enter screen (utility) |
| Standard accelerate | 200ms | Exit screen (utility) |

CSS easing values:
- Emphasized: `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`
- Emphasized decelerate: `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1)`
- Emphasized accelerate: `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15)`
- Standard: `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`
- Standard decelerate: `cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0, 1)`
- Standard accelerate: `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1)`

## Jetpack Compose (primary)

Use **`androidx.compose.material3`** with `MaterialTheme` and Material 3 composables (`Scaffold`, `Button`, `NavigationBar`, top app bars, etc.).

- **Theming**: `MaterialTheme(colorScheme = …, typography = …, shapes = …)`. Prefer `dynamicLightColorScheme` / `dynamicDarkColorScheme` on **Android 12+ (API 31+)** when dynamic color is desired; otherwise `lightColorScheme` / `darkColorScheme` or generated theme code from Material Theme Builder.
- **Adaptive UI**: Window size classes, list-detail and supporting-pane layouts, foldables — see `references/layout-and-responsive.md` and `references/navigation-patterns.md`.
- **Edge-to-edge & insets**: Lay out content with `WindowInsets` / scaffold padding so bars and IME behave correctly — see `references/layout-and-responsive.md`.
- **Experimental APIs**: Some Material 3 APIs require `@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)` or expressive opt-ins; match your BOM and compiler.

```kotlin
MaterialTheme(
    colorScheme = colorScheme, // from dynamicLightColorScheme / lightColorScheme / etc.
    typography = Typography(),
    shapes = Shapes(),
) {
    // M3 content — prefer references for Scaffold, navigation, text fields
}
```

## Web (limited): @material/web

**Important:** Per [Material Design 3 for Web](https://m3.material.io/develop/web), **Material Web Components are in maintenance mode** and **M3 Expressive is not implemented on Web**. Use `@material/web` for token-backed web UIs when appropriate, but do not treat it as equivalent to Compose for current Expressive features.

### Setup

```bash
npm install @material/web
```

### Import Components Individually

Always import only the components you use — importing the entire package bloats the bundle:

```javascript
// Good — individual imports
import '@material/web/button/filled-button.js';
import '@material/web/button/outlined-button.js';
import '@material/web/textfield/outlined-text-field.js';
import '@material/web/icon/icon.js';

// Bad — never do this
import '@material/web'; // imports everything
```

### Basic Usage

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto+Flex:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/icon?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body>
  <md-filled-button>Get started</md-filled-button>
  <md-outlined-text-field label="Email" type="email"></md-outlined-text-field>

  <script type="module">
    import '@material/web/button/filled-button.js';
    import '@material/web/textfield/outlined-text-field.js';
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

### Theming with CSS Custom Properties

Apply a custom theme by setting CSS custom properties on `:root` or any ancestor:

```css
:root {
  /* Color scheme (generate with @material/material-color-utilities) */
  --md-sys-color-primary: #6750A4;
  --md-sys-color-on-primary: #FFFFFF;
  --md-sys-color-primary-container: #EADDFF;
  --md-sys-color-on-primary-container: #21005D;

```

### Component-Level Overrides

Override individual component tokens for specific customization:

```css
md-filled-button {
  --md-filled-button-container-color: var(--md-sys-color-primary);
  --md-filled-button-label-text-color: var(--md-sys-color-on-primary);
  --md-filled-button-container-shape: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-full);
  --md-filled-button-container-height: 40px;
}

md-outlined-text-field {
  --md-outlined-text-field-container-shape: var(--md-sys-shape-corner-small);
  --md-outlined-text-field-focus-outline-color: var(--md-sys-color-primary);
}
```

### Dark Theme

Apply dark theme by overriding color tokens on a class or media query:

```css
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --md-sys-color-primary: #D0BCFF;
    --md-sys-color-on-primary: #381E72;
    --md-sys-color-primary-container: #4F378B;
    --md-sys-color-on-primary-container: #EADDFF;
    --md-sys-color-surface: #141218;
    --md-sys-color-on-surface: #E6E0E9;
    --md-sys-color-surface-container: #211F26;
    --md-sys-color-outline: #938F99;
    --md-sys-color-outline-variant: #49454F;
  }
}
```

Full theming guide: `references/theming-and-dynamic-color.md`
